what_is_it_about: Six-part ABC Audio and 20/20 series on the December 2016 disappearance and murder of 19-year-old Sarah Stern in a small New Jersey beach town. It starts as a missing person case after her abandoned car is found on a bridge, and the suspect turns out to be a childhood friend. Hosted by Juju Chang.
who_is_it_for: Fans of polished network-news true crime and missing person cases.

what_is_it_about: Six-part limited series from Exactly Right Media and Adonde Media, hosted by Martina Castro, on the Brazilian faith healer John of God: the people drawn to his promise of healing, the journalists who exposed him and the prosecution that took him down. Premiered 4 February 2026, with a Spanish-language feed (Dos Caras: Juan de Dios).
who_is_it_for: Listeners who like investigative cult and abuse-of-power stories.

podcast_name: Dead Certain: The Martha Moxley Murder
what_is_it_about: NBC News Studios series hosted by Andrew Goldman that re-examines the 1975 murder of 15-year-old Martha Moxley in Greenwich, Connecticut, after Michael Skakel's conviction was overturned, and asks who else could have done it.
who_is_it_for: Cold case and wrongful conviction fans.

what_is_it_about: Pushkin Industries series from Hayley Fox and Betsy Shepherd investigating the June 1998 disappearance of Los Angeles County deputy Jon Aujay, who vanished during a run in Devil's Punchbowl park, California.
who_is_it_for: Missing person and cold case listeners.

what_is_it_about: Sony Music series hosted by Jonathan Hirsch on the 2011 death of Dominique 'Nique' Leili, whose husband secretly surveilled the family with hidden cameras, using never-before-released recordings.
who_is_it_for: Listeners who want a domestic-crime story built on primary-source audio.

what_is_it_about: Ten-part series from Stephanie Tinsley on police investigative mistakes in the 2007 murder of Danny Harris near Memphis, Tennessee, which led to a wrongful conviction.
who_is_it_for: Wrongful conviction and justice-system accountability fans.

what_is_it_about: Audible and Campside Media series about identical twin brothers Anh and Trung, both suspects in a murder at a party they attended, and whether eyewitness accounts can be trusted when suspects look alike.

podcast_name: Crime Next Door: The Beast of Birkenhead
what_is_it_about: BBC Sounds series hosted by Olivia Graham on the 1986 murder of Diane Sindall in Birkenhead and the case against Peter Sullivan, who was convicted and then cleared by DNA evidence 38 years later. Examines the investigative errors and their effect on the Sindall family.
who_is_it_for: UK listeners interested in miscarriages of justice.

podcast_name: Inside Murder Trial: Girl In The River
what_is_it_about: BBC Radio Scotland series with Jane MacSorley and Thomas Ross KC following the 2023 trial of three accused in the 1996 murder of 14-year-old Caroline Glachan in West Dunbartonshire. Each episode covers one day in court, with analysis from a defence advocate.
who_is_it_for: Courtroom fans who want day-by-day trial coverage.

what_is_it_about: Weekly Mercury Podcast Network series covering true crime, dark history and the motivations behind crimes. Launched 14 January 2026.
who_is_it_for: UK listeners who want a calm, researched weekly show.

what_is_it_about: Mercury Podcast Network show created and hosted by Mark Randell on the lives, deaths and legacies of celebrities, mixing biography, true crime and cultural history. Launched 12 January 2026 with episodes on Caroline Flack, Aaliyah and Gene Hackman.
who_is_it_for: Listeners drawn to celebrity deaths and their fallout.

what_is_it_about: Six-part series hosted by Naomi Channell on criminal scandals at UK funeral homes, where families were told loved ones had been neglected, lost or abused, in an industry that is currently unregulated.
who_is_it_for: Investigative listeners who like consumer-scandal stories.

what_is_it_about: Three-part Irish Sun series narrated by Nicola Barren on the murders of Esther and her foster daughter Jessica by Esther's husband Frank McCann, with interviews with family members and the Gardai involved.

LiSTNR series hosted by Tara Cassidy on the 2017 murder of Bruce Saunders, staged to look like a farming accident and allegedly orchestrated by his ex-partner Sharon Graham. Appeals are expected in 2026.

7 News series hosted by Michael Usher and Cassie Zervos on the August 2025 Porepunkah shooting in Victoria that killed two police officers, Dezi Freeman's months on the run, the manhunt, and his death in a police shooting on 30 March 2026.
who_is_it_for: Australian listeners following a recent, high-profile case.
